answer: Sequential proof-of-humanity queue. Each identity must answer a fresh, unaided spatial reasoning task generated from a hidden karst terrain map, issued only after the prior identity resolves; throughput is capped by one human solver per polling interval. An attacker gains no haven from parallel bots—each fake identity pays real human minutes and serial wait, and a wrong plume of clues in one answer resets that slot’s proof, doubling the delay cost per identity.
